data_fields.name: defaultGroundSpeed
data_fields.donor_constant: 150 when the tile has ground speed 0

data_fields.name: followedInputPenaltyPerQueuedStep
data_fields.donor_constant: 10 ms per queued pre-walk, minimum one queued

data_fields.name: predictionDropPad
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 ms added to max(step duration, ping)

data_fields.name: viewportWidenPerWalkAxis
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 tile on both sides of the walk axis

best_idea: Drive the world camera's focus from the character's logical position and let it lag by the unfinished part of the current step (clock time), so it eases between tiles instead of snapping, and never moves the character.
decision_why: Take the glide-over-the-step shape for the third-person world focus; do not take the 10 ms per queued input rule (input backlog would change fight timing) or the walk-direction viewport widening (visibility is zone data and server-owned).
acceptance: A player holds forward in a zone: the third-person focus eases over the step duration from the previous tile to the new one, reaches the tile at the end, and does not jump when the server confirms a matching move; a test asserts focus at 0%, 50% and 100% of a step equals from, midpoint and to.
